evidence_items.explanation: The launch paper reports one model spanning dialogue, captions, games and real robot control, including human-level or better performance on 23 Atari games, while acknowledging frequent poor dialogue responses. Its prior-work comparison supports novelty in that combined coverage, rather than novelty of multimodality itself.

This earlier model combined speech, image and language tasks. It limits any suggestion that Gato invented multimodal models, but does not establish the same combined coverage of games and real robot control.
